Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashwini Bhushan,
Advocate For the State : Ms. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P.
--------

1. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

This is the third bail application filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with the prayer to release on bail in connection with R C Case No. 07(A) of 2016 D, registered under Section 120B read with Sections 406,409,420,467,468,471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(d) of P.C. Act and Section 66 & 66(C) of IT Act, 2000, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge, CBI-cum Addl. Sessions Judge-II, Dhanbad.

entities.text: Court of learned Special Judge, CBI-cum Addl. Sessions Judge-II, Dhanbad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the first bail application being B.A. No.3544 of 2022 has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 27.04.2022 and the second bail application has been rejected in B.A. No.12378 of 2022 vide order dated 11.05.2023 and the petitioner has renewed the Bail Application on the ground that after rejection of the Bail Application of the petitioner twice, he is ready to pay the rest of the amount within a period of one year.
4. The plea raised on behalf of the learned counsel for the petitioner cannot be accepted as new ground for the third bail application.
Accordingly, this bail application of the petitioner is hereby rejected.
